title: Fourier degree of a computed function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $A$ be a set of available coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, and let $T$ be a real-valued decision tree indexed by $A$. If $T$ computes a function $f$ from the binary cube to the reals, then the vector Fourier degree of $f$ is at most the depth of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
$T$ is a decision tree indexed by $A$ with real-valued leaves
$f$ is a real-valued function on the binary cube
